_comment: The one table behind delay causes in the app and the server (task: causes in the selected language). trv: Trafikverket announcement codes (TrainAnnouncement.Deviation[].Code) -> locale key cause.<slug>; trvText: Trafikverket texts that have no code in the list; dt: Digitraffic cause codes (category A, detailed A1, third A101) -> key, null when no honest short translation exists (the resolver then uses the parent code, then shows the Finnish name). kind: cause (says why a train is late) or notice (carriage, platform or service note, not a reason). verified: true = the en/sv wording in the String Catalog was checked against the official text (_official, from _source) on 2026-11-07; false = no official text exists (_note). Trafikverket's own Swedish text (sv) is theirs. Read by packages/shared/src/delayCauses.ts and ClackCore/Logic/DelayCauses.swift (copied by scripts/ios/sync_assets.py).

_source.trv: Trafikverket Open API, object type ReasonCode (group Annonseringstexter, non-deleted ANA001-ANA155), Level3Description is the announced Swedish text; fetched 2026-10-24. ANA066 (Test) and ANA099 ({Fritext}) are left out; ANA200 and up are bus-stop and gate names, not causes. The "Orsaker nya principer" group (IBT01, JVA01 ...) is the planners' internal cause tree and is never announced, so it is not mapped. Re-fetched 2026-11-07: the 81 codes and texts are unchanged.
_source.trvText: The earlier hard-coded table in the app: texts without a code in the ReasonCode list.
_source.dt: Digitraffic metadata cause-category-codes, detailed-cause-category-codes and third-cause-category-codes (https://rata.digitraffic.fi/api/v1/metadata/...); the Finnish names (fi) are theirs, only in Finnish: the metadata carries no passengerTerm or other sv/en text (checked 2026-11-07). The en/sv wording is Clack's translation of the Finnish name, reviewed against it on 2026-11-07 (verified).

_rjComment: rj: Rejseplanen's Danish notices, matched on their heading by regular expression (first match wins), to a locale key; named groups fill the key's {{placeholders}}. Meanings from Den Danske Ordbog (ordnet.dk): elevator = lift, ude af drift = out of order, spor = platform track, vogne = coaches, aflyst = cancelled, sporarbejde = track work, signalfejl = signal fault, togbus = rail replacement bus, forsinket = delayed. Seen in DSB's messages on 2026-10-28 (DENMARK_DATA_FINDINGS.md).
